ios.desc:
Vocabulary is the root of language learning – do you agree? To master English, German, and Chinese, you need an effective and natural way to learn words. That’s exactly why Vocadaily was created – to help you build a strong language foundation through vocabulary, one step at a time, every day!

With Vocadaily, you can:
• Learn new words effortlessly through notifications and widgets woven into your daily routine.
• Get instant Vietnamese translations for deeper understanding.
• Customize vocabulary categories and levels to match your skill set.
• Personalize your learning schedule to fit your lifestyle and peak focus times.
• Save favorite words for quick review and remove ones you’ve already mastered.
• Perfect Your Pronunciation: Nail every word with our smart pronunciation scoring feature, available for all languages!

Vocadaily brings you five popular languages – English, German, Japanese, French, and Chinese – with clever features that make vocabulary learning a fun, natural part of your day. Whether you’re gearing up for work conversations, planning a trip, or simply expanding your linguistic horizons, Vocadaily empowers you to confidently use new words in no time.

Start your language journey today! Unlock a world of opportunities through language, one word at a time.

Hey HN,

I created Vocadaily to make vocabulary learning effortless. Most people struggle with consistency, so Vocadaily uses daily notifications, widgets, and smart exercises to keep new words in sight and easy to practice.

Why Vocadaily?
 Curated Word Lists – Learn by topic & difficulty.
 Smart Exercises – Quizzes & real-world usage.
 Pronunciation Guides – Improve speaking skills.
 Notifications & Widgets – Learn without opening the app.
 Supports English, Chinese, Japanese, German, French, & more.

I’d love your feedback. URL: https://vocadaily.com/
